about: Voice fast-path baselines from spaces/scripts/bench-voice --write. A measurement more than 25% over its baseline fails core/ffi/tests/speed.rs (the startup number has a 10 ms floor). rtf is null until measured on a Mac with a speech model (POLYCARP_BENCH_MODELS).

panel.about: The extension's side panel opening, in a throwaway Chromium: scripts/panel-speed.mjs. Bytes are enforced by test/panel-size.test.mjs; times depend on the Mac's load, so they're recorded here and not enforced.
panel.measuredOn: 2026-11-07, Mac under load average 15, four alternating pairs

longDictation.about: One voice, 45 s and up, nine speakers: core/ffi/tests/speed.rs long_dictation_in_pieces. Wait after release.

spacesTiming.about: Budgets in ms for every event kind Spaces writes to timing.log: switch (a switch between two workspaces, its done= mark), parked (the same switch's parked= mark), and each `open <kind>=` line (settings-pane is any `open settings-<pane>=`). scripts/speed-report.sh checks the last day of the real timing.log against them and exits 1 on a miss; SpeedBudgetTests fails when the app logs a kind with no budget here. A percentile is judged only with minSamples lines or more. measured is the owner's Mac, 2026-11-16 to 11-17 (council brief polycarp-mac.md); budgets are tightened from it toward the targets in the 2026-11-17 gap list (P1 to P5, X2), so today's log is expected to miss some.
